svg.title: From intent to evidence
svg.desc: Human direction, bounded agent work, independent review, qualification, production and a real-use evidence return form a complete operating circuit. System model: From intent to evidence. HUMAN. Set intent Goal · limits Owner. Coding agents Bounded tasks Reviewable changes. Independent review Check the exact candidate. Production Observe the named live version. Real use People · devices A separate test. RETURN TO THE HUMAN Evidence changes the next decision. Qualification Named checks on the same candidate. Revise the work No publication from a rejected review. Method, not portfolio status. Review, production and real use are different observations.
